warnings: Structural roof framing plan (steel rafters/purlins with a legend and dimensioned grid) -- classified as pattern:'plan' per primary_rawjson_schema.md's roof_plan-vs-plan rule, NOT roof_plan.

จันทันเหล็ก (main rafters, ⌷150x75x6.5x10mm) are drawn as continuous thick lines at each row (E,D,C,B) running the full roof width edge-to-edge (including both 1.20m eave overhangs), with no drafted joint/break at the columns -- recorded as ONE continuous span per row ('edge' to 'edge') rather than split at 1/2/3, since §5's beam-splitting rule is for framed RC beams and this member visibly rests through its supports. Flagged as a judgment call.

แปเหล็ก (purlins, ⌷125x50x20x3.2mm @ spacing per drawing) run perpendicular to the rafters and are spaced roughly 1.00m apart based on a secondary dimension row printed under the right portion of the sheet (1.00+1.00+~1.10+1.00+1.00, an approximate reading) -- recorded as ONE repeated-member entry with spacing_mm per schema §6a rather than enumerating every individual purlin position; the secondary dimension row itself is kept in the grid master's unassigned_dimensions as a purlin-spacing chain, not as new grid lines (purlins are not beam endpoints).

SAG ROD (ø15mm round bar, diagonal ties bracing the purlins against the rafters) recorded as an accessory note on the purlin entry rather than its own plan element -- it has no grid position of its own.

CX posts repeat the same 4 positions (E2,D2,C2,B2) already recorded on S-04 (อะเส plan) -- this sheet re-draws them as the base of the roof structure; not double-counted as a separate structural quantity, just cross-referenced.
